any job involving many people and large money
a work of major importance involving huge men and material
an organized team work to achieve a set task within the time limit

uniform demand of resources is achieved

q: 15. Military type of organization is known as

q: 17. Hoe is primarily used to excavate
options: below the natural surface of the ground on which the machine rests
trenches requiring precise control of depth
pits of basements requiring precise control of depth
explain: A hoe digs below its own level, including trenches and basement pits.

q: 18. The main purpose of planned maintenance of roads is:
options: to keep road surface in a good condition
to reduce the vehicle operation costs
to reduce the total transportation costs
explain: Planned road maintenance primarily aims to reduce vehicle operation costs by keeping roads in a condition that minimizes wear and fuel consumption for users.

q: 20. Project maintenance is
explain: Project/asset maintenance is a continuous, ongoing process throughout the life of the facility, not a one-time or optional activity.

q: 21. A construction team includes
explain: The owner, engineer and architect are all part of the team.

q: 22. The field of activities of an engineer includes
options: approval of construction plans by the local authority
inspection and payment of work done by contractor
explain: All of these fall within the engineer's field.

q: 23. Responsibility of civil Engineer is
explain: A civil engineer's responsibilities span supervision, quality control, and BOQ preparation - all of the above.

q: 24. Construction activities at site are associated with the management of

q: 25. Construction activities at site are associated with the management of

q: 26. Technology is the
options: study of machines and their operation
study of behaviour of men and machines
explain: Technology, by definition, is the study/application of techniques and methods for performing tasks.

explain: The procurement process begins with the client specifying their requirements before proceeding to estimation and sourcing.

q: 28. The types of construction in which more equipment are used, is known as capital intensive while the construction in which more human labours are used, is called
explain: Labour-intensive construction relies primarily on manual human effort rather than heavy machinery or automated equipment.

options: a rule or a set of rules never to the violated
a definite rule along which one has to proceed
a procedure for preparing the project report
a set of broad guidelines stipulated by management
explain: In management, a policy serves as a high-level guide that sets the boundaries for decision-making and aligns actions with organizational goals.

q: 30. The 1st stage of a construction is
explain: Before any financial or procurement activity begins, the project must be conceptualized and the formal proposal initiated.

q: 31. Site order book is used for recording
explain: A site order book is a legal record where the engineer or site in-charge writes specific instructions for the contractor to follow.

q: 32. The purposes of preparing job-layout for a construction project is :
options: reduction in wastage & deterioration of materials
explain: The specific answer in the key emphasizes that a job-layout minimizes material handling distances, thereby reducing wastage and damage.

q: 33. The main principle of an organization, is
explain: Effective organizations rely on clear command structures, delegation to empower staff, and control mechanisms to ensure goals are met.

q: 34. The main advantage of line organization is
options: ability to quick decision at all level
explain: Line organization is the simplest form of hierarchy, providing clear authority, discipline, and rapid decision-making.

q: 35. The main disadvantage of line organization is
explain: A major drawback is that authority is concentrated at the top, which can lead to autocratic leadership and lack of specialized input.

q: 36. Military organization is known as
explain: Line organization is often called military organization because it follows a direct vertical chain of command similar to armed forces.

q: 37. Frederick W. Taylor introduced a system of working known as
explain: F.W. Taylor, the father of Scientific Management, introduced functional foremanship where specialists lead specific functions.

q: 38. Line & staff organization is mostly suitable for
explain: This hybrid model combines direct authority (line) with expert advice (staff), making it suitable for both simple and complex large-scale projects.

q: 39. Project maintenance is:
explain: Project/facility maintenance continues throughout the operational life of the project as an ongoing process.

q: 40. Project maintenance is concerned with
options: maintenance of useful life of plant
to maximize the return on investment
explain: Maintenance ensures equipment longevity and efficient operation, which ultimately protects the financial investment.

q: 41. Preventive maintenance is a types of

q: 42. Modular co-ordination of construction means proper
explain: Modular coordination involves standardizing dimensions across planning, design, and execution to improve efficiency and reduce waste.

q: 43. The most popular type of organization used for civil engineering construction is:

q: 45. Construction management involves :

study of behaviour men and machines
explain: Per the answer key, b.

q: 49. In order to balance the needs of the many stakeholders involved in a project, the most desirable method to achieve resolution of conflicts would be:
explain: Compromise is generally the most desirable method to balance and resolve conflicting stakeholder interests fairly.

options: Explicitly, in advance of committing to the budget
Implicitly, to allow for a management reserve
At the time the budget is prepared
